old_caption: The video opens with a serene winter landscape, featuring a dense forest of tall, slender trees standing against a backdrop of a cloudy sky. The ground is blanketed in a layer of snow, with patches of exposed earth visible through the snow's surface. As the scene progresses, a slow, continuous emission of smoke begins from a single point on the snowy ground, gradually increasing in volume and spreading outward. The smoke billows outward, creating a dramatic contrast against the stillness of the surrounding forest. The camera remains static throughout the smoke emission phase. The video concludes with a sudden, violent explosion at the smoke source, producing a large cloud of smoke and debris that obscures the scene.
original_wisa_caption: The video opens with a serene winter landscape, featuring a dense forest of tall, slender trees standing against a backdrop of a cloudy sky. The ground is blanketed in a layer of snow, with patches of exposed earth visible through the snow's surface. As the scene progresses, a small explosion occurs on the snowy ground, sending a burst of smoke and debris into the air. The smoke billows outward, creating a dramatic contrast against the stillness of the surrounding forest. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, capturing the explosion from a fixed position, allowing viewers to observe the full extent of the blast and its immediate aftermath. The video concludes with the smoke gradually dissipating, leaving behind a quiet, undisturbed snowy field and the towering forest in the background.
caption: A pale, snow- or ash-covered clearing stretches before a dense stand of tall, dark pine trunks beneath an overcast sky. From a fixed point near the center of the frame, a vertical column of white smoke already rises and continues to ascend, slowly gaining height and opacity while drifting toward the right. The forest, the ground texture, and the source location remain put throughout, with no camera motion evident. For most of the excerpt the scene is essentially static apart from this steady emission and the plume's gradual rightward spread. Near the end a small pink-red glow appears at the base of the smoke column, intensifying briefly before a bright white burst erupts at that ground point, throwing lens-flare streaks across the trees. The flash then collapses into a low, expanding white cloud of smoke and dark fragments around the source, while the original plume above still persists.

If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
